description: This file defines various UI components for a React application, including Container, Card, Button, Input, Select, Table, Alert, Loader, and StatCard, utilizing theme styling.

methods.name: Container({ children, style })
methods.description: A container component with a maximum width and centered layout.

methods.name: Card({ children, style })
methods.description: A styled card container with background, border, border-radius and shadow.

methods.name: Button({ children, variant = 'primary', style, ...props })
methods.description: A stylized button component supporting different variants with hover and active effects.

methods.name: Input({ label, error, style, ...props })
methods.description: An input field with label and error message support.

methods.name: Select({ label, error, children, style, ...props })
methods.description: A select dropdown with label and error message support.

methods.name: Table({ columns = [], data = [], emptyText = 'No data', style })
methods.description: A table component displaying data with customizable columns and handling empty state.

methods.name: Alert({ type = 'info', children, style })
methods.description: A colored alert box indicating message type such as info, success, or danger.

methods.name: Loader({ text = 'Loading...' })
methods.description: A simple loading indicator with optional text.

methods.name: StatCard({ label, value, trend, color = theme.colors.accent })
methods.description: A card displaying a statistic with optional trend indication.

ctags.name: Select
ctags.pattern: /^export function Select({ label, error, children, style, ...props }) {$/

ctags.name: StatCard
ctags.pattern: /^export function StatCard({ label, value, trend, color = theme.colors.accent }) {$/

ctags.name: Table
ctags.pattern: /^export function Table({ columns = [], data = [], emptyText = 'No data', style }) {$/
